name: a16z Style Captions
summary: One click turns a talking-head Draft into a 9:16 Short in the a16z house style: framing, editorial captions, keyword cards, B-roll, name tag and music.

compatibility.selects: Development build only. Released-version compatibility is unverified. Shared YuNet framing requires selects.ai and selects-ai-runtime installed from the same library revision (Selects 2.0.570 or later).

de.name: a16z-Stil-Untertitel
